## New-Contact / CRM-lite Updater (v2 — decodes MIME-encoded subjects/names)

**Flow:** Gmail Trigger (all inbox mail) → Filter Candidates → [Any Candidates? IF] → Gmail: Search Prior Emails (one combined query for every candidate sender) → Match & Log New Contacts → Loop Over Items (1 at a time, 5s apart) → Build Gemini Request → Gemini (one-line summary + purpose) → Parse & Build Contact Row → Wait → back into the loop → Google Sheets Append → Slack notify → Gmail: Mark Processed.

**How "first-time" is detected:** for every candidate sender in this run, it searches Gmail for ANY earlier message from that address (excluding every message from candidate senders THIS batch, not just one). No hits = genuinely new contact.

**v2 fix:** subjects/sender names containing non-ASCII characters (em dashes, accents, emoji) arrive from Gmail as raw MIME encoded-word text (e.g. =?UTF-8?Q?...?=) when Simplify is off. Filter Candidates now decodes these back to readable text before anything else sees them.

**v3 fix:** the HTTP node's built-in "batching" option wasn't actually spacing out Gemini calls, causing 429 rate-limit errors when several new contacts arrived in one run. Replaced with an explicit Loop Over Items + Wait pattern that processes exactly one contact every 5 seconds, guaranteed regardless of n8n version.

**IMPORTANT — execution modes:** `Build Gemini Request` and `Parse & Build Contact Row` are set to "Run Once for Each Item" (Settings tab). `Filter Candidates` and `Match & Log New Contacts` use the default "Run Once for All Items".

**Before activating:**
1. Credentials: Gmail (trigger + search + label), Gemini (PaLM) API, Google Sheets, Slack.
2. `Filter Candidates`: set EXEC_EMAIL and, optionally, INTERNAL_DOMAINS.
3. Sheet headers: name, email, firstContactDate, subject, purpose, summary, status, emailId, threadId, loggedAt — already set in `Google Sheets: Append Contact`.
4. `Gmail: Mark Processed` and `Slack: Send Notification` are currently disabled for mock testing — re-enable and configure (real label, confirm channel) before going live.
